leadText: Volume 1 is the first volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga. Authored and illustrated by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.
plainText:
Volume 1 is the first volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga. Authored and illustrated by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: In Search of the Legendary Pokémon Dialga!!
Chapter 2: Hareta's Very First Pokémon Battle!!
Chapter 3: The Mystery Boy, Jun!!
Chapter 4: Win with Teamwork!!
Chapter 5: Find Munchlax!!

==Important events==
Hareta meets Mitsumi.
Professor Rowan sends them on a quest to find .
Hareta meets Team Galactic for the first time.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
Hareta's in DPA01
Hareta's in DPA03
Hareta's in DPA04

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:

==Gym Battles==
Hareta defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Roark in DPA02
Gardenia in DPA04

==D・P Snapshots==
Sneaking a Bite (ぬすみ食い)
Rock the Target's World! (ターゲット、　ロックオン！)
Misdreavus, rocking the world of its victim! (ムウマ、　おどろかす相手をロックオン！)
Piplup, rocking the world of its victim! (ポッチャマ、　つつく相手をロックオン！)
Chase (かけっこ)
From the front (前)
From the back (後ろ)

==Character summary==
===Hareta's party===
 

==Trivia==
 
As the English volumes do not have dust covers like the Japanese ones, part two of the back cover gag is lost in the English release. The front cover image is moved to the end of the volume and changed into an explanation of the direction the book reads in.
===Errors===
In the D・P Snapshots section, "ターゲット、　ロックオン！" (Target: Lock on!) is mistranslated as "Rock the Target's World!".
